extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys, and applicants filing/defending patents or utility models in Japan
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehensive Examination Guidelines published by the Japan Patent Office for examination and handling of patent and utility model applications in Japan, detailing statutory requirements (enablement, novelty, inventive step, claims, amendments, priority, unity, etc.) and procedural practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination (chapter heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Chapter 1 of Part I (PDF referenced in TOC) for detailed principles and procedural flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures of Examination (chapter heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part I, Chapter 2 and its sections for specific procedural rules applied during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifying Claimed Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1: Specifying Claimed Invention (chapter/section heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how to interpret and specify the claimed invention in claim construction and examination (see referenced PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art Search and Determination of Novelty, Inventive Step, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2: Prior Art Search and Determination of Novelty, Inventive Step, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers searching prior art and legal/technical criteria for assessing novelty and inventive step; see Section 2 PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Reasons for Refusal
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3: Notice of Reasons for Refusal (procedural heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and content required when issuing a notice of reasons for refusal (see section PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of Written Opinion, Written Amendment, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 4: Handling of Written Opinion, Written Amendment, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on processing applicants' written opinions and amendments during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 5: Decision (procedural heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and standards governing examiners' decisions (grant/refusal) are provided in the referenced section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision of Dismissal of Amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 6: Decision of Dismissal of Amendment (procedural heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and process for dismissing proposed amendments (see section PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconsideration by Examiners before Appeal Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 7: Reconsideration by Examiners before Appeal Proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines procedures for internal reconsideration prior to formal appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication with Applicant and Request for Documents etc. Required for the Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 8: Communication with Applicant and Request for Documents etc. Required for the Examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for examiner-applicant communications and documentary requests necessary for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable periods and applications of These Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicable periods and applications of these Guidelines (meta guidance on when the guidelines apply).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies effective dates and transitional application of older guidelines vs. revisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling Procedures for Examinations involving Product-by-process Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling Procedures for Examinations involving Product-by-process Claims (special handling guidance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate page referenced for full text; provides special procedures when product-by-process claim formats are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Description
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 1: Requirements for Description (general heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains specific sub-requirements such as enablement and disclosure of prior-art information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enablement Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1: Enablement Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for whether the description enables a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention; see PDF for details and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements specified by ministerial ordinance relating to the description; see referenced text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Disclosure of Information on Prior Art Documents (Patent Act Article 36(4)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3: Requirements for Disclosure of Information on Prior Art Documents (Patent Act Article 36(4)(ii)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obligations regarding disclosure of known prior art in the description; see section PDF for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 2: Requirements for Claims (general heading).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains statutory claim requirements and subcriteria (support, clarity, conciseness, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Act Article 36(5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1: Patent Act Article 36(5) (referenced statutory provision governing claims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See section PDF for interpretation and how Article 36(5) is applied in examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2: Support Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(i)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirement that claims be supported by the description; see guidance and examples in PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3: Clarity Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(ii)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for clarity of claims, including interpretation rules and problematic formulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conciseness Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 4: Conciseness Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iii)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules on conciseness of claim sets and avoidance of redundant claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement on Statement of Claims (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 5: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement on Statement of Claims (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iv)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal statement/format requirements for claims set by ministerial ordinance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention (Patent Act Article 37)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 3: Unity of Invention (Patent Act Article 37).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria for determining whether multiple inventions share a single inventive concept; see guidance and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Unity of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: (Reference) Requirements for Unity of Application — applied to the application on or before December 31, 2003.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical/transitionary unity rules applicable to older applications (see referenced PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Patent and Industrial Applicability (Article 29(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 1: Eligibility for Patent and Industrial Applicability (Main Paragraph of Article 29(1) of Patent Act).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for statutory subject-matter eligibility and industrial applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty (Patent Act Article 29(1) and (2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 1: Novelty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition and assessment of novelty against prior art; see Section 1 PDF for details and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step (Patent Act Article 29(1) and (2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 2: Inventive Step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and frameworks for assessing inventive step/non-obviousness; see Section 2 PDF for methodology and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure of Determining Novelty and Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 3: Procedure of Determining Novelty and Inventive Step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step procedure and examiner practice for combining prior art and reasoning about novelty/inventive step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims Including Specific Expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 4: Claims Including Specific Expressions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how certain expressions in claims are treated for novelty/inventive step and clarity (see PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions to Lack of Novelty of Invention (Patent Act Article 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 5: Exceptions to Lack of Novelty of Invention (Patent Act Article 30).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statutory exceptions that preserve novelty despite prior disclosure under specific conditions; see text for examples and criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secret Prior Art (Patent Act Article 29bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 3: Secret Prior Art (Patent Act Article 29bis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules on how secret prior art (e.g., earlier-filed but unpublished applications) affects novelty and priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Application (Patent Act Article 39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 4: Prior Application (Patent Act Article 39).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treatment of earlier-filed applications and their effects on novelty/priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category of Unpatentable Invention (Patent Act Article 32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 5: Category of Unpatentable Invention (Patent Act Article 32).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists/defines statutory categories of subject matter excluded from patent protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Amendments (Patent Act Article 17bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 1: Requirements for Amendments (Patent Act Article 17bis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General standards for allowable amendments to description, claims or drawings during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Adding New Matter (Patent Act Article 17bis(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 2: Amendment Adding New Matter (Patent Act Article 17bis(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules prohibiting/adjudicating amendments that add new subject-matter beyond the original disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Changing Special Technical Feature of Invention (Patent Act Article 17bis(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 3: Amendment Changing Special Technical Feature of Invention (Patent Act Article 17bis(4)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for amendments that alter the special technical feature and when such changes are permissible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment for other than the Prescribed Purposes (Patent Act Article 17bis(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 4: Amendment for other than the Prescribed Purposes (Patent Act Article 17bis(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls on use of amendments for purposes not allowed by statute; see the PDF for prohibited purposes and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority under the Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Part V, Chapter 1: Priority under the Paris Convention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and procedures for claiming and proving priority under the Paris Convention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Part V, Chapter 2: Internal Priority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules governing priority claims based on earlier domestic filings or internal priority systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division of Patent Application (Patent Act Article 44) — Requirements for Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 1, Section 1: Division of Patent Application (Patent Act Article 44) — Requirements for Division of Patent Application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and timing for filing divisional applications, and requirements that must be met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice under Article 50bis
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 1, Section 2: Notice under Article 50bis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural rule regarding notices under Article 50bis; see section for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion of Application (Patent Act Article 46)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 2: Conversion of Application (Patent Act Article 46).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules allowing conversion between different application types and the conditions for conversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Application Based on Utility Model Registration (Patent Act Article 46bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 3: Patent Application Based on Utility Model Registration (Patent Act Article 46bis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure and requirements for filing a patent application based on prior utility model registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference filing (Patent Act Article 38ter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 4: Reference filing (Patent Act Article 38ter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on filings that refer to other materials/applications under Article 38ter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Foreign Language Written Application System
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VII, Chapter 1: Overview of Foreign Language Written Application System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level description of the system permitting foreign-language filings and the procedural framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Foreign Language Written Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VII, Chapter 2: Examination of Foreign Language Written Application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed procedures and special rules for examining applications filed in a foreign language (large PDF referenced).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Patent Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VIII: International Patent Application (PCT-related guidelines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on handling international (PCT) filings entering the Japanese national phase and related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of a Patent Term as Compensation for the Curtailment of the Term (Patent Act Article 67(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IX, Chapter 1: Extension of a Patent Term as Compensation for the Curtailment of the Term (Patent Act Article 67(2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of Patent Term for Pharmaceutical Inventions (Patent Act Article 67(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IX, Chapter 2: Extension of Patent Term for Pharmaceutical Inventions (Patent Act Article 67(4)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific rules for term extension applicable to pharmaceutical patents; see details in PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic Requirements for Utility Model Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Part X, Chapter 1: Basic Requirements for Utility Model Registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the substantive and formal requirements unique to utility model registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility Model Technical Opinion

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevant Provisions / Statutory Cross-References
